facts.fact: 中文：KRAY 早上 8:00 敲 Wacker 的门；Wacker 开门时脸颊发红。
facts.anchor: KRAY knocked on Wacker’s door at 8:00 a.m.

facts.fact: 中文：KRAY 说 GOOWIKI 项目的麻烦是他想不出怎么把所有的钱花掉。
facts.anchor: The problem is I can’t figure out how to spend all the money.

facts.fact: 中文：KRAY 复述 Wacker 的交待：以 Transformational Human Resources 顾问身份发出 1000 份 NOC，并有两百亿美元可用。
facts.anchor: you said we need to get out a thousand NOCs as Transformational Human Resources consultants and have twenty billion dollars to do it with

facts.fact: 中文：KRAY 算出平均每名官员的预算为 ████ 百万美元。
facts.anchor: an average budget of ████ million dollars per officer

facts.fact: 中文：Wacker 纠正 KRAY：两百亿是年度预算。
facts.anchor: Twenty billion is the annual budget.

facts.fact: 中文：Wacker 说运营经费由相关运营部门出，每年只有几亿美元，是小钱。
facts.anchor: just a few hundred million a year

facts.fact: 中文：Wacker 拒绝让 KRAY 看 GOOWIKI 备忘录，称其远超出 KRAY 的薪资级别。
facts.anchor: that’s way, way above your pay grade

facts.fact: 中文：Wacker 让 KRAY 遇到 HR 问题就去找 EVERSHAG。
